definitions: Relating to the earliest period of the Cenozoic Era, spanning from about 66 to 23 million years ago, characterized by the rise of mammals and the formation of modern continents.
Denoting or relating to the system of rocks formed during the Paleogene period.
examples: The Paleogene period saw significant global cooling.
Many Paleogene fossils have been discovered in the region.
The Paleogene rocks provide insights into ancient climates.
